name: Louisiana
dueDateNotes: Louisiana follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: Louisiana taxes your income at a flat 3% (2025 reform) after a $12,500 standard deduction ($25,000 for joint filers).
uniqueFacts: Louisiana replaced its old graduated brackets with a flat 3% income tax starting in 2025.
Louisiana's standard deduction is a generous $12,500 for single filers and $25,000 for joint filers.
Louisiana requires estimated payments once you expect to owe more than $1,000 in state tax.
